claims.statement: GPSR requires a responsible EU economic operator for covered products, which may be an authorised representative, and assigns document, traceability and corrective-action tasks; a Warsaw entity can acquire this control point through a narrowly scoped written mandate and custody of each product's technical file, after product-liability counsel defines accepted categories.

A non-EU seller without responsible-person and safety information can lose EU listing visibility or market access; eBay says it may hide non-compliant listings, while the regulation requires responsible-operator, product and warning information in distance-sale offers, creating a measurable lost-sales and remediation event.

The payer is a UK, US or Asian marketplace brand's compliance or EU sales owner, using compliance/customer-acquisition budget when a marketplace warns or hides a listing; the Commission notes penalties must be dissuasive and eBay directs sellers to obtain EU Responsible Person details, indicating a mandatory gate rather than optional software.

contrary_evidence: EU importers and fulfilment providers can already serve as the responsible economic operator, so many sellers will not need a standalone representative.
Acting as authorised representative creates real safety, recall and authority-cooperation obligations that software alone cannot satisfy.

economics.acquisition_route: Target low-risk non-electrical categories sold by UK marketplace agencies, sign category-limited authorised-representative mandates, and require a complete risk assessment and technical file before the service activates.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Pilot 100 SKUs across 10 sellers, reach 500 brands averaging PLN 12,000 annual fees for PLN 6m recurring revenue, and reinvest into compliance staff and insurer-backed processes; a 25-35% operating margin could support PLN 5m founder net worth in 5-7 years, but liability may cap bootstrapped scale.
economics.founder_time: Founder builds document intake, listing checks and incident triage for 3 hours daily; a product-safety professional and counsel approve categories and handle regulator-facing decisions.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Document automation is high margin, but professional review, insurance and incident response are meaningful; preliminary blended gross margin target is 45-60%.
economics.payback: Seller payback comes from preserving EU listing revenue; require annual prepayment so initial legal review and insurance are recovered before representation begins.
economics.pricing: PLN 2,000-5,000 onboarding per product family plus PLN 500-2,000 monthly base and PLN 20-80 per active SKU; recalls and laboratory work priced separately.
economics.retention_or_repeat: The EU address, technical-file custody and incident history persist for every active SKU; annual reviews and new-SKU additions create repeat revenue and high switching friction.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Category-specific technical-file templates, marketplace error data and incident history improve acceptance screening and price risk more accurately than generic address-rental services.
fingerprint.customer: Non-EU small and mid-sized marketplace brands selling low-risk consumer products into the EU without their own EU entity or importer.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: UK and US marketplace agencies, fulfilment advisers and product-testing laboratories refer sellers at listing launch.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Category-limited EU authorised representation bundled with technical-file escrow, listing-data validation and incident workflow for recurring per-SKU fees.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The seller's compliance or EU sales budget pays to keep a product legally offerable and prevent marketplace hiding or enforcement interruption.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Launching an EU listing, receiving a GPSR marketplace warning, or losing the current EU responsible operator.

founder_fit: The founder is EU-based and can automate document validation and multilingual evidence handling from Poland.
Agency and laboratory channels reduce the need for continuous high-energy founder sales.
The operation can start with a tightly bounded, low-risk category and scale as a process and data asset.
risks: A dangerous product could create recall costs, regulator action or liability beyond fee income.
Professional indemnity or product-liability insurance may be unavailable or uneconomic for a startup.
Low-cost address-only incumbents can undercut pricing, while marketplaces may internalize the role.

structure.control_point: Category-limited EU authorised-representative mandate and custody of the SKU technical file
structure.critical_dependency: Affordable liability coverage and the ability to reject unsafe or under-documented products

thesis: Do not sell a nominal EU address: acquire a product-family mandate only after machine-assisted technical-file screening, then remain the retained responsible-person workflow that keeps listings complete and coordinates incidents, recalls and authority requests.
title: GPSR Technical-File Gatekeeper
uncertainties: Counsel must determine the exact liabilities and duties accepted under each mandate.
Demand and attainable pricing among non-EU marketplace sellers are unmeasured.
The safest initial product categories and insurer exclusions remain unknown.
